newsitem.title: UK: LONDON PRECIOUS METALS CLOSE MOSTLY SHARPLY FIRMER.
newsitem.headline: LONDON PRECIOUS METALS CLOSE MOSTLY SHARPLY FIRMER.

text.p: GOLD - Closed around day's high at $324.60/$325.10 vs $321.90/$322.40 previously. Rally began in New York, continued after initial resistance taken out.
SILVER - Finished two cents firmer at $4.40/$4.42.
PLATINUM - Closed up $8.00 at $442.00/$445.00. Rallied overnight on Nymex, Tocom short covering. Impala strike supportive.
